title: Data Scientist
relevant_certs: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate
text:
Job title: Data Scientist

We are hiring a Data Scientist to join our team.

Required skills: Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Statistics, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Nice to have: Deep Learning, Spark, Docker.
Experience: at least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.
Education: degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or Data Science; a Master's degree or PhD is a plus.
Certifications appreciated: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty, Google Professional Data Engineer, TensorFlow Developer Certificate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate.
Soft skills: communication, teamwork, problem solving, autonomy.
Languages: English and French required (professional proficiency).

title: Backend Software Engineer (Java)
relevant_certs: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Developer
text:
Job title: Backend Software Engineer (Java)

We are hiring a Backend Software Engineer (Java) to join our team.

Required skills: Java, Spring Boot, SQL, REST APIs, Docker, Git.
Nice to have: Kubernetes, Kafka, AWS.
Experience: at least 4 years of professional experience in a similar role.
Education: degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or Computer Engineering; a Master's degree or PhD is a plus.
Certifications appreciated: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
Soft skills: teamwork, communication, leadership, problem solving.
Languages: English required (professional proficiency).
